[hr][h2]依赖[/h2] [list] [*][b]TailorMade: Unified Apparel & Body Refitting[/b] (astryl.tailormade) [/list]
[hr][h2]说明[/h2] 本模组通过 Harmony 运行时翻译，不修改原模组的任何文件。
[hr][h2]源码[/h2] [url=https://github.com/QianYI-Yan/RimworldMods/tree/main/TailorMade-ZhCN]github.com/QianYI-Yan/RimworldMods[/url]
